name: tsundoku-codegen
description: Isolated toolchain for `just generate-frontend-sdk`. @hey-api/openapi-ts uses the classic TypeScript compiler API (ts.SyntaxKind et al), which TypeScript 7 no longer exposes -- it ships only `tsc` and `unstable/ast`. Pinning TypeScript 5 here lets the app keep TypeScript 7 for type checking.
